subject.title: [Bug]: SSH control tunnel restarts on a fixed 2s delay with no escalation or attempt cap

question: After the SSH tunnel exhausts retries, should Remote-over-SSH remain terminal until the user explicitly retries or the effective tunnel configuration changes, and where should that recovery be surfaced?
rationale: The tunnel is request-driven, so a bounded retry policy needs a product contract for when the app may safely resume automatic attempts rather than copying node-worker lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Bound per tunnel identity and require explicit recovery
options.body: Use escalating delays with a cap, reset only when the effective SSH target/configuration changes, and provide a visible Retry control plus terminal diagnostic.

options.title: Keep automatic retries but escalate indefinitely
options.body: Reduce spawn pressure with backoff while retaining unattended recovery, but preserve no final operator-visible failure state.

options.title: Keep the current flat retry policy
options.body: Avoid new recovery semantics but retain continuous process and log churn for permanently unreachable targets.

recommendation.title: Bound per tunnel identity and require explicit recovery
recommendation.body: Use escalating delays with a cap, reset only when the effective SSH target/configuration changes, and provide a visible Retry control plus terminal diagnostic.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged macOS retry-policy work provides the closest documented owner-boundary context for choosing the tunnel-specific recovery contract.
